title: Effect of Applying 1% Metformin on Guided Bone Regeneration Processes with Bovine-Derived Xenografts. 5
authors: Montalbán-Vadillo, O., Pérez -Pevida, E., Viteri -Agustín, I., Chávarri -Prado, D., Estrada -Martínez, A., Diéguez-Pereira, M., Sánchez-Lasheras, F., & Brizuela-Velasco, A. (2024). Journal of clinical medicine, 13(10), 2973.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss Jason membrane (porcine pericardium) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The local application of a 1% metformin solution in an animal model of guided bone regeneration with particulate bovine hydroxyapatite and hyaluronate resulted in greater bone neoformation and xenograft osseointegration than in the control group” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
